pages.title: Cosmic Die
pages.text: A die holding a galaxy-scale computation folded into a square I can pinch between two fingers. Its traces stretch across light-years inside the fold. In the dark it glimmers faintly, like a patch of night sky.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Cutting a Cosmic Logic Wafer in the Planck-Scale Cutter, I worried the light-year traces would unfold. Superfluid helium held them still while the cutter separated each die.
Made in $(item)Planck-Scale Cutter$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Multiverse.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cosmic Processor, Unified Notes III.
